title: Gas exchange in two samples of germinating seeds
body: A student placed two samples of germinating seeds, X and Y, in separate respirometers kept at the same temperature in the dark, so that no photosynthesis could occur. She measured the volume of oxygen taken in and the volume of carbon dioxide given out by each sample over two hours. Sample X consumed 50 mL of oxygen and released 50 mL of carbon dioxide. Sample Y consumed 50 mL of oxygen and released 35 mL of carbon dioxide. She knew that the ratio of the volume of CO2 evolved to the volume of O2 consumed depends on the type of substrate being respired, and she wanted to use her readings to identify the main respiratory substrate in each sample.
